# Advice on the proposed inventory correction

Dear ⟦PERSON|Alvena McRusk⟧,

We have considered the proposed correction to the inventory and the explanation supplied by the storage company. The correction should identify the omitted page rather than suggest that the page was part of the set originally inspected. That distinction matters because the delivery acknowledgement records only the documents present at collection.

Please preserve the first inventory with the corrected copy. A later reader should be able to establish what changed, when it changed and which source supports the addition. Replacing the earlier file without that information would make the collection record harder to explain.

The proposed inspection charge is GBP 75. Our client is prepared to consider that charge after receiving a description of the work undertaken. Approval of a copying charge does not amount to agreement about the condition of the stored goods or release of a separate repair claim.

Please send the revised wording to ⟦EMAIL|inventory.review@moss-quoin.invalid⟧ before 15 February 2027. Paragraph 4.3 of the deposit terms continues to govern inspection of originals.

Yours faithfully,

⟦PERSON|Gavira Vennick⟧ KC

For and on behalf of ⟦ORG|Moss Quoin Legal LLP⟧

Reviewed by ⟦PERSON|Nerovan Rillane⟧ QC.
